positions.as_written: Use a fluid sensitive sequence in all three planes, because oedema is the signal that carries most of this study.
Read the marrow signal first in an equivocal study, since it is present early and resolves later.
Assess the cartilage surfaces, because an impaction injury damages them at the same instant.
